description: Deprecated frequency divider, kept only so that old patches go on loading; its browser name says do not use it, and Voltage Controlled Frequency Divider MkII replaces it

params.text: Scales the voltage at the CV input before it reaches the division ratio, from -100% at one end through nothing at the centre to +100% at the other
Sets the division ratio by hand across a range of 0 to 10

inputs.text: Voltage that shifts the division ratio, added to the MANUAL setting once the CV knob has scaled it
The signal being divided; every edge of it advances the count

outputs.text: The divided signal, switching between -5V and +5V
The divided signal, switching between 0V and 10V

notes: this version divides by 2, 4, 6, 8 and so on rather than by 1, 2, 3, 4; the MkII module set to Legacy Mode reproduces that behaviour

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
